title: RestoreEvidence
description: The payload of lease.restore_recorded/v1 (docs/design/m0/05 "Evidence-target leases"): the outcome of one restore of a lease's evidence target, recorded when the restore runs, under the lease's subject. lease.restore_verified names a verified one by its receipt. internal/lease checks, from the log alone, that it is recorded while the lease restores, for the lease's attempt and one of the targets its grant recorded, under a receipt id not used before.

receipt.description: The restore's receipt, which lease.restore_verified names.

attempt.description: The evidence run the restore follows.

cycle.description: The lease's restore cycle: 1 after its first lease.restore_started, one more after each.

verified.description: Whether the restore was verified: the target is back as it was.

detail.description: What the restore observed; non-empty when it was not verified.
